provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Republic of Trinidad and Tobago. Parliamentary republic.
rulers: President Christine KANGALOO (since 20 March 2023); Prime Minister Kamla Susheila PERSAD-BISSESSAR (since 1 May 2025)
economy: high-income Caribbean economy; major hydrocarbon exporter; key tourism and finance sectors; high inflation and growing public debt; long foreign currency access delays; large foreign reserves and sovereign wealth fund GDP (PPP): $43.362 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Trinidad and Tobago Defense Force (TTDF): Trinidad and Tobago Regiment (Army/Land Forces), Trinidad and Tobago Coast Guard, Trinidad and Tobago Air Guard, Defense Force Reserves (2026) Expenditure: 0.9% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
